paper_metadata.title: Research progress on Ti2AlNb-based alloys and composites for aerospace applications

evidence.quote: Ti2AlNb-based alloys have attracted extensive interest for aerospace applications as they exhibit high specific strength, reasonable room-temperature ductility, acceptable fracture toughness, and excellent creep resistance.
Ti2AlNb matrix composites are discussed that reinforced by ceramic particles, ceramic fibers/whiskers, carbon nanomaterials, and so on, which improve the properties accordingly.
